_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for startup-trip-point-pex on the `klt sim` harness (issue #387).
The per-experiment half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes every piece of ARGUMENT from this file.
Claim: sg13g2-bandgap's bandgap_startup circuit, re-simulated with XMSENSE/XMKFB/XRPU geometry and every wire R/C taken from the routed layout/bandgap_startup/bandgap_startup.gds extraction (as regenerated for issue #380), engages at cold start (core sense node at 0 V => det pulled to >= 80% of vdd, fb held below 100 mV) and disengages once the core is running (det below 20% of vdd, fb above 80% of vdd), with a trip point strictly inside (0, vdd), across the full PVT grid. The six-criteria verdict is applied per point by sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py (kind trip-point; same formula as sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh). Post-layout (PEX) evidence, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row.
Devices: XMSENSE/XMKFB -- sg13_hv_nmos (PSP103.6 via psp103.osdi); XRPU -- rhigh (r3_cmc via r3_cmc.osdi); body/bulk tied to the ideal vss (documented simplification, README.md).
Netlist provenance: layout/bandgap_startup/bandgap_startup.pex.spice (klt extract --deck sg13g2 --parasitics): device geometry and wire R/C hand-carried into testbench/startup_trip_point_pex.body.spice.tmpl as the legacy hybrid X-subckt netlist; run_klt_sim.sh gates every run on the body's wire values still being present in the committed extraction, and the record's Extraction sources field binds the exact pex.spice bytes.
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image.
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} (MOS-hv x resistor sections; no bipolar) x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
